etymology.historical_story: The Raja Ravi Varma Heritage Foundation traces the name Varma to Sanskrit varman, associated with armour, protection, or a shield. The name also forms part of the painter Raja Ravi Varma’s name, whose artistic legacy the foundation preserves. This explains a documented personal-name usage; it does not establish varma as a Malay common noun or prove that this is the intended input. [Source: Raja Ravi Varma Heritage Foundation](https://rrvhfoundation.com/index.html).
